key_insight: AI can help decode, predict, and mitigate instability in all-inorganic CsPbX3 perovskites by linking degradation mechanisms to design strategies.
engineering_relevance: This framework supports more reliable perovskite devices by guiding stability screening, failure diagnosis, and materials/process optimization for photovoltaics, detectors, and LEDs.
evidence_signal: The review highlights that AI is especially useful because instability studies face multimodal data, coupled degradation pathways, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification challenges.
watch_item: Performance can be misleading without standardized datasets, consistent testing protocols, and interpretable models that transfer across materials and device domains.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
